templates.doc: Flavor rows as templates[] list (vampire.json) or lane dict {court_fae: [...], ...} (fae.json, corpse_eaters.json). Validated as hostile.template (key + description).

name_pools.doc: Gendered name pools {male: [...], female: [...]} for random spawns.

name_pool.doc: Single flat name pool (some lanes, e.g. purgatory territorial).

roles.doc: Role-keyed spawn rows (hunters, criminals) with stats + tier.

room_stage_by_panic.doc: Croatoan panic level -> stage id map.

barks.doc: Stage-keyed ambient bark lines for croatoan_act.
